5.5FT FRP Hard Tri-Fold Tonneau Cover Fits for 2022-2026 Toyota Tundra (Excl. Trail) - Fits 5.5' Bed CrewMax Cab with Deck Rail System

Upgrade your 2022-2026 Toyota Tundra with this FRP Hard Tri-Fold Tonneau Cover, designed exclusively for models with a 5.5 ft bed and Deck Rail System (excluding Trail Edition). Built with high-strength fiberglass panels, this cover offers superior protection from the elements and sharp objects, ensuring your cargo stays safe. Installation is quick and easy—no drilling needed—thanks to the included embedded clamps and bulletproof wrench clamp. Plus, with added features like a nylon strap for securing the cover and a complimentary LED light for enhanced visibility, this tonneau cover is both practical and durable. Whether you're hauling gear or hitting the road, you’ll have peace of mind knowing your truck bed is secure.

Superior Cargo Protection: Built with high-strength fiberglass (FRP) panels, this hard tri-fold tonneau cover offers exceptional protection against rain, snow, and road debris. It also resists impact and sharp objects, keeping your cargo safe and secure in all conditions.

Quick, No-Drill Installation: Designed for hassle-free setup, this FRP hard tri-fold tonneau cover installs easily with clear instructions and requires no drilling. Get it mounted quickly and ready to use. (Note: Cargo racks must be removed prior to installation.)

Heavy-Duty Durability You Can Trust: Reinforced fiberglass panels deliver long-lasting strength and impressive load-bearing capacity. A robust locking system keeps the cover firmly closed while driving, giving you confidence on every trip.
